import { MeshStandardNodeMaterial, MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix, smoothstep } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry, PointLight, RepeatWrapping } = ctx.THREE;
  const group = new Group();

  const disposables = [];
  const timelines = [];

  // 1. Stage / Backdrop Plane (~8x6 at z=-1.5) to eliminate flat-void defects
  const bgGeom = new PlaneGeometry(8, 6);
  disposables.push(bgGeom);

  const bgMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial();
  disposables.push(bgMat);

  const uvNode = uv();
  const bottomBgColor = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063); // #0b0b10 ink/dark-surface
  const topBgColor = vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114);    // #16161d ink base
  const distFromCenter = uvNode.sub(0.5).length();
  const radialGlow = smoothstep(0.6, 0.1, distFromCenter).mul(vec3(0.2, 0.02, 0.03)); // subtle signal red ambient aura
  
  bgMat.colorNode = mix(bottomBgColor, topBgColor, uvNode.y).add(radialGlow);

  const backdrop = new Mesh(bgGeom, bgMat);
  backdrop.position.set(0, 0, -1.5);
  group.add(backdrop);

  // 2. Beautiful Soft Radial Contact Shadow below the main card
  const shadowGeom = new PlaneGeometry(2.8, 0.6);
  disposables.push(shadowGeom);
  
  const shadowMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.5
  });
  disposables.push(shadowMat);
  
  const shadowUv = uv();
  const shadowDist = shadowUv.sub(0.5).length();
  const shadowAlpha = smoothstep(0.5, 0.0, shadowDist);
  shadowMat.colorNode = vec3(0.0, 0.0, 0.0);
  shadowMat.opacityNode = shadowAlpha.mul(0.55);

  const shadow = new Mesh(shadowGeom, shadowMat);
  shadow.position.set(0, -1.6, -0.05);
  shadow.rotation.x = -Math.PI * 0.45;
  group.add(shadow);

  // 3. Machined Metal Pricing Card
  const cardGeom = new PlaneGeometry(2.3, 3.1);
  disposables.push(cardGeom);

  const cardMat = new MeshStandardNodeMaterial({
    roughness: 0.55,
    metalness: 0.52,
    clearcoat: 0.22,
    clearcoatRoughness: 0.12
  });
  disposables.push(cardMat);

  const cardUv = uv();
  const inkColor = vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114);      // #16161d
  const surfaceColor = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063);  // #0b0b10
  const cardBase = mix(surfaceColor, inkColor, cardUv.y);

  // Accent pinstripe red margin styling around card edge (#ff2a38)
  const marginL = smoothstep(0.0, 0.015, cardUv.x).sub(smoothstep(0.015, 0.025, cardUv.x));
  const marginR = smoothstep(1.0, 0.985, cardUv.x).sub(smoothstep(0.985, 0.975, cardUv.x));
  const marginB = smoothstep(0.0, 0.015, cardUv.y).sub(smoothstep(0.015, 0.025, cardUv.y));
  const marginT = smoothstep(1.0, 0.985, cardUv.y).sub(smoothstep(0.985, 0.975, cardUv.y));
  const marginMask = marginL.add(marginR).add(marginB).add(marginT);

  const accentColor = vec3(1.0, 0.165, 0.22); // #ff2a38
  const finalCardColor = mix(cardBase, accentColor, marginMask.mul(0.6));

  cardMat.colorNode = finalCardColor;

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeom, cardMat);
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // Load PBR anisotropic brushed-metal textures
  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl || '/prism-assets/chrome/brushed-metal.map.png';
  ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((tex) => {
    tex.wrapS = RepeatWrapping;
    tex.wrapT = RepeatWrapping;
    tex.repeat.set(3, 4);
    cardMat.roughnessMap = tex;
    cardMat.metalnessMap = tex;
    cardMat.needsUpdate = true;
  }).catch((err) => {
    console.warn('Could not load brushed metal mapping', err);
  });

  // 4. Studio Product Lighting Setup
  // Soft cool-neutral main key light
  const keyLight = new PointLight('#e8ecf2', 1.1, 7.0);
  keyLight.position.set(-2.5, 2.0, 2.0);
  group.add(keyLight);

  // Warm crimson accent rim light to define card silhouette
  const rimLight = new PointLight('#ff2a38', 1.3, 5.0);
  rimLight.position.set(2.5, -1.8, 1.2);
  group.add(rimLight);

  // Drifting dynamic lighting to interact with metallic surface/roughness details
  const dynamicLight = new PointLight('#ff2a38', 0.5, 4.5);
  dynamicLight.position.set(0, 2.5, 0.8);
  group.add(dynamicLight);

  // 5. Animations & Motion Design
  // Dynamic light drifting
  const lightMove = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1, yoyo: true });
  lightMove.to(dynamicLight.position, {
    x: 1.8,
    y: -2.0,
    duration: 7.0,
    ease: 'sine.inOut'
  });
  timelines.push(lightMove);

  // Entrance movement
  cardMesh.position.y = -0.3;
  cardMesh.scale.set(0.96, 0.96, 0.96);

  const entrance = gsap.timeline();
  entrance.to(cardMesh.position, {
    y: 0,
    duration: 1.0,
    ease: 'power3.out'
  });
  entrance.to(cardMesh.scale, {
    x: 1,
    y: 1,
    z: 1,
    duration: 1.2,
    ease: 'elastic.out(1, 0.8)'
  }, 0);
  timelines.push(entrance);

  // Gentle, micro-interactive spatial drift (to avoid raw absolute static feels)
  const subtleDrift = gsap.timeline({ repeat: -1, yoyo: true });
  subtleDrift.to(cardMesh.rotation, {
    y: 0.04,
    x: 0.02,
    duration: 5.5,
    ease: 'sine.inOut'
  });
  timelines.push(subtleDrift);

  // 6. Mandatory explicit cleanup lifecycle hook
  group.userData = {
    handlers: {},
    cleanup() {
      timelines.forEach(tl => tl.kill());
      disposables.forEach(d => d.dispose());
    }
  };

  return group;
}
